name: robots/sail-research-lab__robust-gymnasium
title: robust-gymnasium CartPole-v1 (classic control)
intro: robust-gymnasium CartPole-v1 (classic control), adapted from sail-research-lab/robust-gymnasium. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
